svg.title: ANOVA found a difference. Where is it?
svg.desc: A significant ANOVA gives evidence that at least one population mean differs. Many post-hoc procedures exist. Tukey HSD compares every pair of group means.
svg.text: Do all groups have the same population mean?
A significant result gives evidence that at least one mean differs.
Which pairs of means differ? Several procedures can answer this.
Tukey HSD compares every pair in one family.
